in_arabic.name: روبل
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من روب و بيل بمعنى الشخص القوي و الجريء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم روبل هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القوة و الجرأة، و يعود في أصوله إلى اللغة العربية، حيث يشتق من جذور لفظية تعبر عن الشجاعة و الصلابة. يستخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية لما يحمله من صفات حميدة.

in_urdu.name: روبیل
in_urdu.meaning: روبل کا مطلب ہے مضبوط اور ہمت والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: روبیل ایک ایسا نام ہے جو عربی زبان کی جڑوں سے نکلا ہے اور اس کا تعلق مضبوطی اور ہمت سے ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے کیونکہ اس میں بہادری اور قوت کی صفات پائی جاتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: रोबील
in_hindi.meaning: रोबील का अर्थ है मजबूत और साहसी व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: रोबील नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है और यह नाम शक्ति और साहस के अर्थ में प्रयोग किया जाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी इस नाम का महत्व है क्योंकि इसमें वीरता और दृढ़ता के गुण पाए जाते हैं।

in_pashto.name: روبېل
in_pashto.meaning: روبېل د قوي او زړور سړي په معنا دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د روبېل نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دود کې دی، چې د قوت او زړورتيا صفات لري. دا نوم د اسلامي ارزښتونو او پښتونولي دودونو سره تړاو لري.

data.cultural_impact: The name Robeel in the Islamic culture is loved and revered by many due to its uniqueness and powerful meaning. It is a name that embodies the ideal qualities of strength, power, and compassion - traits that are highly valued in Islamic society. A name like Robeel can command respect and admiration, as it suggests that the individual carries within them the strength and power to overcome challenges, while also possessing the gentleness and compassion to treat others with kindness and empathy.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name Robeel holds deep significance as it reflects the divine attributes of Allah. Allah is described in the Quran as being Al- Quddus (The Holy), Al-Jalil (The Compassionate), and Al-Jamil (The Beautiful). Robeel, with its meaning of being both strong and gentle, offers a reminder of Allah's divine attributes and encourages us to emulate them in our daily lives. Additionally, the name Robeel can be seen as a reminder of the importance of balance and harmony in our spiritual journey. We must strive to be strong and powerful in our faith, yet gentle and compassionate in our actions towards others. Through the name Robeel, we are reminded of the noble character traits that Allah has bestowed upon us and encourages us to live up to that potential. Overall, the name Robeel carries a powerful and spiritual significance that inspires us to be strong in character, compassionate towards others, and always striving towards Allah's pleasure.

historical_references.reference: Robeel ibn Abi Awafa was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad and one of the Ten Promised Paradise. He was a scribe for the Prophet and played a significant role in the recording of Hadith. He was known for his generosity and piety.

Robeel Al Ghamri was a famous Sufi saint of the 13th century. He is known for his deep spiritual experiences and teachings on love and devotion to God. He was also a poet and wrote many verses expressing his mystical insights.
